mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student) AS studentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teacher) AS teacherCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course) AS courseCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_selection cs LEFT JOIN semester sem ON sem.id = cs.semester_id WHERE sem.is_current = 1) AS selectionCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clazz) AS clazzCount
SELECT d.name AS name, COUNT(s.sid) AS value FROM department d LEFT JOIN clazz c ON c.did = d.did LEFT JOIN student s ON s.cid = c.cid GROUP BY d.did, d.name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN total < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below60, SUM(CASE WHEN total >= 60 AND total < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s60to70, SUM(CASE WHEN total >= 70 AND total < 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s70to80, SUM(CASE WHEN total >= 80 AND total < 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s80to90, SUM(CASE WHEN total >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above90 FROM score WHERE total IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(cs.id) AS value FROM course_selection cs LEFT JOIN course c ON cs.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN semester sem ON sem.id = cs.semester_id WHERE sem.is_current = 1 GROUP BY cs.course_id, c.name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT t.name AS name, ROUND(AVG((er.dim1 + er.dim2 + er.dim3 + er.dim4) / 4.0), 1) AS value FROM evaluation_record er LEFT JOIN teacher t ON t.tid = er.teacher_uid GROUP BY er.teacher_uid, t.name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_arrange WHERE exam_date >= CURDATE() AND exam_date < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS weekExamCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teach_task WHERE status = 0) AS pendingTaskCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_arrange) AS totalExamCount
